# Embassy v1.9.2 — the network says why

The v1.9.0 two-machine drill found exactly one gap: when the very first dial to a peer fails fast, there were no mirrors yet to mark stale — so the failure was invisible, and an hour of elimination stood in for one line of evidence. Now a bounded, host-scoped `PEER_DIAL_FAILED` names the failing stage (spawn vs initialize) with zero mirrors present, clears on the first valid catalog, and never surfaces raw SSH output.

Upgrade: `npm install -g agent-embassy@1.9.2`, restart your brokers.
